frequency_question: How often do authorities increase the countercyclical capital buffer above zero during a comparable window?
membership_rule: Includes G20 banking regulators with an active countercyclical capital buffer framework operating under Basel III guidelines over a multi-year window. Excludes jurisdictions without an active framework.
window: A multi-year window of up to 5 years corresponding to the length of the financial cycle.
coverage_note: 8 instances across major jurisdictions with active frameworks; 6 hits, 2 misses.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions with limited historical data.
validity_reason: Macroprudential regulatory frameworks and Basel III implementation standards remain stable over medium-term horizons.
